title: Amazing experience
text: Such a wonderful tour with amazing sightseeing and a wonderful guide. Lots of awesome, fun facts and history from our guide Philip and such a beautiful way to see the city for the first time. Will definitely be doing another tour in Budapest and Lisbon!
author: Emily_Y

title: Saw more of Barcelona - fantastic!
text:
Alex was a terrific guide! With just two of us on the tour, he asked what we had seen and where we might want to go. He checked out our Segway experience in a small square nearby, showing us an original city wall and making sure of our skills. 

His notebook of photos included original Barcelona, several buildings, and maps. We’re fascinated by cities’ growth in history. Loved that perspective. 

We rode through narrow alleys and smiled at shopkeepers opening for the day and people going to work. Actually we smiled the whole time. 

By the beach, there are smooth, paved, safe, marked bike lane
author: Janet_B

title: Excellent.

author: X1796UXsashad

title: Must do
text: The small group was perfect, they catered to what we wanted to see, so knowledgeable, and Alex was amazing!  We loved this tour so much we booked again the next day for 2 hours!
author: Alisha_E

title: Segway is such fun!
text: Brilliant fun & informative! There were 3 of us who had used segways before so we were off pretty sharpish. We went all along the beach front & back through the old Olympic area & the Catalan area....Great fun & would def recommend
author: Denisedowney

title: A fun experience!
text: It’s first time for us to try Segway tour! I was skeptical if I could be balanced on it at the beginning , but it was much easier to handle than I thought!  It is much easier to navigate around the city and of course, thank you so much for the guide who gave us a very good tour about the area, history etc …
author: Lulunext

title: Lots of fun on the Segway
text: Had a wonderful time with our family of 7 touring around the port of Barcelona with Ivan and Dennis.   They showed us how to use the Segway and it was actually very easy and we had now mishaps whatsoever.   Lots of fun and I highly recommend for a group.

title: Family tour in and around Barcelona
text: Great tour - Ivan the instructor was helpful knowledgeable and we all thoroughly enjoyed the tour - this was a great way to explore the city and feel like we were able to get to know the city better
